draft.subject: Guaranteed reimbursement on every claim
draft.body: We guarantee reimbursement and your claims will not be denied. JotPsych runs alongside the system you already use and takes about five minutes to set up. Notes and claims are checked against payer rules before they go out. Reply stop and I will take you off the list.
